definitions.trivial: Historical effort label; no size replacement is assigned.
definitions.moderate: Historical effort label; no size replacement is assigned.
definitions.significant: Historical effort label; no size replacement is assigned.
definitions.blocked-external: Historical external-blocking label; it does not establish effort size.
definitions.xs: Extra-small effort-size label, ordered before s; no duration threshold is defined.
definitions.s: Small effort-size label, ordered between xs and m; no duration threshold is defined.
definitions.m: Medium effort-size label, ordered between s and l; no duration threshold is defined.
definitions.l: Large effort-size label, ordered between m and xl; no duration threshold is defined.
definitions.xl: Extra-large effort-size label, ordered after l; no duration threshold is defined.

trivial.note: No unconditional canonical size mapping is established.

moderate.note: No unconditional canonical size mapping is established.

significant.note: No unconditional canonical size mapping is established.

blocked-external.note: The importer preserves blocked_external independently; unknown effort size is null.

standard.none: Project-defined effort labels; no external standard is adopted.
